## ICompanionIndexPresentationContext interface

The review body's companion index: every companion pull request the review creates, then every existing one the caller named, in that order.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ICompanionIndexPresentationContext extends IPresentationContext 
```
**Extends:** [IPresentationContext](./sarif-to-comment.ipresentationcontext.md)

## Remarks

`required` holds every companion's `link`<!-- -->, so the result keeps every entry and each number leads to its own pull request; no link may lead elsewhere. When the review creates companion pull requests, the callback runs twice: during preparation with placeholder numbers (above 2,000,000,000), to check it before anything is written, and once more with the real numbers, when the review is composed after they exist.
